facts.text: Tim expressed appreciation for John's support and wished for John's injury to heal.

evidence.quote: Thanks! Appreciate your support. I hope your injury heals soon.
Sure thing, Tim! Got your back. I hope so too.

facts.text: John mentioned that the doctor indicated his injury was not too serious.

evidence.quote: The doctor said it's not too serious.

facts.text: Tim acknowledged that John's injury would prevent him from being on the court.

evidence.quote: I hate not being on the court.
I bet. It's like if I couldn't read due to an injury.

facts.text: John expressed determination to continue pushing forward despite his injury.

evidence.quote: I'm pushing on though. Talk soon!
